dedupe_keys.name: uppsala pwr spent fuel composition and decay library

description: This library contains simulated spent-fuel composition and decay properties for a generic pressurised-water-reactor fuel-pin geometry. Uppsala University researchers generated the collection with Serpent2 burnup and depletion calculations for uranium-oxide and mixed-oxide fuels. The provider describes 1,321,397 configurations, with columns for operating-history parameters, 279 nuclides and aggregate decay-related quantities. These are calculated states, not measurements from a specific reactor or a calendar monitoring record. Mendeley version 1 supplies a ZIP containing a documented CSV table, free under CC BY-NC 3.0 with non-commercial reuse conditions. The metadata list an archive of approximately 1.7 gigabytes. Geometry and calculation assumptions limit transfer to complete reactor cores or real storage inventories. Modellers could use the tabulation as supporting inputs for spent-fuel management and fuel-cycle simulations. model-cyclus-nuclear-fuel-cycle-simulator is a related modelling resource, without a verified import path. No archive, numerical values or reactor code was downloaded or executed.
